|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Redeemed Apprentice]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB8-04-Redeemed_Apprentice-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-redeemedapprentice-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-04-Redeemed_Apprentice.png]]) show the original text (see [[Redeemed Apprentice]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Redeemed Apprentice]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “If you just forfeited a character (or opponent just drew destiny for Elis Helrot) deploy on table. Whenever you must lose Force from a [Virtual Block 4] objective targeting your non-Jedi character, reduce loss by 1. Elis Helrot and Nabrun Leids are canceled. [Immune to Control]” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-redeemedapprentice-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-04-Redeemed_Apprentice.png]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 28) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) added “that” (“reduce that loss by 1”), printed “non-jedi” and misspelled the second “Helrot” as “Herlot” (as published)<ref name="cl-1281_33-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013</ref>: “If you just forfeited a character (or opponent just drew destiny for Elis Helrot) deploy on table. Whenever you must lose Force from a [Virtual Block 4] objective targeting your non-jedi character, reduce that loss by 1. Elis Herlot and Nabrun Leids are canceled. (Immune to Control).” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-04-Redeemed_Apprentice-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
